Bangalore's rental market is changing rapidly with a growing trend to use managed gated apartments called Kots. Kots are premium flats that provide utmost security and convenience with a managed and professional service offering modern amenities. These premium managed apartments are in demand by young professionals, couples, and families. After several months of research, we put together a list of the top 5 properties of Kots in Bangalore, including location, connectivity, infrastructure, and apartment sizes, so you can decide your next home.

1.Who are We? Understanding Managed Rental Apartments in Bangalore  

Kots are a new-age rental housing concept designed for Bangalore’s urban residents. Unlike traditional rentals or co-living spaces, Kots are fully managed gated communities offering furnished flats with a wide range of amenities and services.

Why Opt for Kots?  

Security: Kots employ gated entry, CCTV, and security guards.

Fully Furnished: Flats provided basic furniture and appliances.
Amenities included: Rooftop greenery, gyms, EV charging station, wash and fold laundry services.
Managed Services: Kots tenants receive support as well as housekeeping and general maintenance of some units. The services help to minimize the tenant hassle.
Community Living: tenants have opportunities to meet and connect with other Kots residents.

3.Top 5 Properties of Kots in Bangalore 


a)  Kots Serein

Kots Serein is located in Serenity Layout, Bellandur, near Sarjapur Road and is perfect for millennials and young professionals.

These are fully furnished leases available in Studio and 1 BHK apartments, and designed for singles, partners or small families. The apartments feature high end furniture package, custom wardrobes, very spacious modular kitchen and 8 inch pure foam mattress for sleeping without worries. In terms of security, onsite security with CCTV cameras, personal access and strict access control and monitoring before entering the compound anytime, you can feel secure. Plenty of space for parking two and four wheelers however, such space can be secured by advance booking day prior use. Residents can have housekeeping as needed, rooftop garden with picturesque view of the city, an in-house gym, EV charging points, washing area, and laundry space for all residences. In addition to these perks, convenient service to wash vehicle and managed food delivery service would make this gated apartment to be safe, trendy, and easy going lifestyle.


  • IT Parks Nearby:
    Ecospace Business Park, RMZ Ecospace.

  • Connectivity:
    Good connectivity via Outer Ring Road and Sarjapur Road with frequent BMTC buses.Bellandur is about to get a new metro station, to be located on the Blue Line (Phase 2A) of Namma Metro located in Bangalore. The station is expected to open by June 2026. The Blue Line will run from KR Puram to the Central Silkboard and will have 13 stations, including Bellandur. 
  • Schools Nearby :
    ORCHIDS The International School,New Horizon Gurukul

  • Hospitals Nearby:
    Sakra World Hospital,Manipal Hospital

  • Entertainment & Shopping:
    Centro Mall, KLM Mall—all within a short drive


b) Kots Huit

Kots Huit is a premium urban gated apartment complex located in Mahadevpura's tranquil Ashraya Layout in Bangalore. Kots Huit is built for urban living. Mahadevpura is a serene residential area with convenient access to the IT corridor. The fully furnished and fully integrated Studio and 1 BHK apartments have contemporary style that is made for singles, couples, and small families. Including a sofa-cum-bed, ample storage (with cupboards and cabinets), and a modular kitchen with an induction stove, refrigerator, microwave, and chimney. Security is done with 24/7 technology-enabled surveillance with CCTV, security guards, and secure doors. Facilities include a rooftop garden with greenery and views; gym; EV charging stations; and terrace laundry provisions. Services include optional housekeeping, vehicle wash, and managed food delivery. If you want to park, enclosed parking for two and four-wheelers will be there to the extent it is available.

  • IT Parks Nearby:

    Bagmane tech park , Ecospace Business Park, International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB).

  • Connectivity:
    Good access via major roads, Sarjapur Road and Outer Ring Road, along with frequent BMTC buses. Mahadevapura in Bangalore is served by Namma Metro's Purple Line. The nearest metro station here is Singayyanapalya (formerly known as Mahadevapura). Singayyanapalya is located on the E-W corridor of the Purple Line and is an elevated station.

  • Schools Nearby:
    Gopalan National School,Gurukul High School

  • Hospitals Nearby:

    Manipal Hospital Whitefield, Kinder Women's Hospital  

  • Shopping & Entertainment:

    Phoenix Marketcity, VR Bengaluru, Nexus Shantiniketan Mall —all within a short drive.

     c) Kots Jour

Kots Jour is an urban gated apartment located in Byreshwara Layout, Hennur, Bangalore.Hennur is Bangalore's premier IT corridor, attracting professionals looking for premium rental apartments.From these flats near Hennur one can find Studio, 1 BHK and 2 BHK with a number of layouts in the apartments, with choices of furnished or semi- furnished.All furnished apartments include new and the best quality furniture, motorized sofa beds in living rooms, and ample storage of cupboards and cabinets included in the apartments, with a modular kitchen with induction stoves, refrigerators, microwaves, and chimneys.Security is extensive with each apartment having 24/7 tech-enabled security plus many other security features. Kots Jour is indeed the best choice for rental apartments in the Byreshwara Layout Hennur area of Bangalore.

  • IT Parks:

    Close proximity to Manyata Tech Park and other major IT hubs.

  • Connectivity:

    Easy access to Manyata tech Park and Hennur does not have direct metro connectivity at the present moment. However, the HRBR Layout Metro Station on the Blue Line which should be completed around June 2026 will greatly enhance connectivity for Hennur residents.

  • Schools Nearby:

    HMR international School,New Horizon International School

  • Hospitals Nearby:

    HOSMAT Hospital,Cloudnine Hospital

  • Shopping & Entertainment:

    Phoenix Mall of Asia, Bharatiya Mall, Elements Mall- all within a short drive.

    d)  Kots Chez

Kots Chez is a urban gated apartment project located at #68, Kaikondrahalli, just off of Sarjapura Road next to the Channakesava Temple, Bangalore. The well-designed and spacious 1 BHK units are open and bright, with a contemporary style of living which is complemented by stylish interiors and high-quality finishes - Practical elegance. The apartments are secure, with 24/7 security guards, CCTV, and door access. Facilities include a fully stocked fitness center, a rooftop garden with plants and trees, landscaped greens as well as free wifi. There are also terrace-type laundry facilities with washers and dryers, and an advanced access control system for ease of use. Housekeeping was incredibly friendly, and also offered vehicle wash and managed food delivery services. Kots Chez is an ideal location for both professionals and families looking for a higher quality living experience in Sarjapur.

  • IT Parks Nearby:

    Close to RMZ Ecospace, Global Technology Park, and other major IT hubs.

  • Connectivity:

    Great access and connectivity via Sarjapur Road and Outer Ring Road. Eventually, Sarjapur will have metro accessibility which is the red line (Phase 3A) of the Namma Metro, and is now expected to connect Sarjapur in the south east to Hebbal in north Bangalore as an entirely new route.

  • Schools Nearby:

    Glentree Academy School  ,ORCHIDS The International School  

  • Hospitals Nearby:

    Motherhood Hospital,Manipal Hospital Sarjapur.

  • Shopping & Entertainment:
    Centro Mall,Forum The Prestige City —all within easy reach, offering a balanced lifestyle of work and leisure.

e) Kots Vingt

Kots Vingt is a premium gated urban apartment complex located at #3 & #4, Behind Fern City, Alpine Eco Road, Doddanekundi, Mahadevpura, .Mahadevapura as a peaceful residential neighbourhood offers great connectivity to major IT corridors.these Studio and 1 BHK flats are spacious with excellent ventilation and come with premium finishes. The interior is modern and functional. Each apartment comes fully furnished and has a modular kitchen with spacious cupboards and high quality cooking appliances. Security is comprehensive with 24/7 security guards onsite, CCTV coverage, secure door access and more. Amenities include a rooftop garden, a gym with good equipment, EV charging stations, terrace laundry (washing machine + dryer) and more. Managed services provided by friendly assistants include housekeeping with onsite staff, vehicle washing and managed food delivery from leading local restaurants. This is a good option for professionals and families looking for premium, safe and comfortable accommodation in close proximity to a major business area.

      • IT Parks Nearby:
        Bagmane tech park , Embassy Tech Village, Bhoruka Tech Park, RMZ Ecospace, International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB).

      • Connectivity:

        With direct access to major roads such as Outer Ring Road and Whitefield Main Road, access to and easy commuting daily is guaranteed. Mahadevapura in Bangalore is part of the Namma Metro's Purple Line. The closest metro station to Mahadevapura is Singayyanapalya (previously Mahadevapura). Singayyanapalya is an elevated station on the East-West corridor of the Purple Line. 

      • Schools Nearby:
        VIBGYOR Rise CBSE School,Gopalan International School

      • Hospitals Nearby

        Kauvery Hospital,Aster Whitefield Hospital

        •  Shopping & Entertainment:
          Phoenix Marketcity, VR Bengaluru, Nexus Shantiniketan Mall

        6.Conclusion

         Five Kots properties, (Kots Serein, Kots Huit, Kots Chez, Kots Vingt and Kots Jour), in Bangalore are a perfect mixture of security, comfort, and modern conveniences that support fulfilling lifestyle experiences. Their proximity to the central IT core, comprehensive connectivity with upcoming metro and bus interfaces, and locations highly convenient to both professionals and families (with parks to play in or shop for groceries) is unmatched. Each flat is fully furnished, and with services such as 24-hour security, housekeeping, gym, pool, and entertainment facilities, Kots properties represent a new level of urban living for managed gated properties in Bangalore.
